_comment: Seed data for the hotline directory, carried over from the legacy
Hotline.html. Every record is deliberately unverified: nobody has
confirmed these numbers are current, and the application shows them
as 'Not yet verified' until a reviewer records a verification.
To load: run `npm run seed:hotlines` with SUPABASE_URL and
SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY set. It inserts every record unverified and leaves
Before marking any of these verified, ring the number and confirm the
organization answers. A wrong emergency number during a flood is worse
